concerns.text: Task T003 (quickstart documentation) describes a CLI command that runs a full end‑to‑end example, which requires the AIPW estimator implemented in T004. Placing T003 before T004 creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.
Task T004 (AIPW estimator) is a producer for T003, T006, and T007. It is incorrectly marked as parallel‑safe ([P]) and should be scheduled before any task that consumes it.
Task T001 updates `spec.md`. Subsequent tasks (e.g., T002 verification tests) read the updated spec, so T001 is not parallel‑safe despite the `[P]` tag.
Task T002 creates `src/dgp.py`, a core artifact consumed by T006, T007, and T003. Marking it `[P]` is unsafe; it must precede any downstream consumer.
Task T005 provides model wrappers required by T006 and T007. It cannot be run in parallel with those consumers, yet it carries a `[P]` tag.
Task T006 builds the single‑replication driver that depends on artifacts from T002, T004, and T005. Its `[P]` tag is inaccurate.
Task T007 orchestrates the full grid and consumes results from T006; it also produces data needed by T008‑T011. It must not be parallel‑safe.
Task T008 aggregates metrics from the interim parquet files generated by T007; therefore it cannot be parallel‑safe.
Task T009 performs meta‑regression on aggregated results from T008; it must run after T008 and is not parallel‑safe.
Task T010 generates heat‑maps from aggregated metrics (T008) and meta‑regression (T009); it must follow those tasks.
Task T011 produces a memory & runtime summary after the grid driver (T007); it cannot be parallel‑safe.
Task T012 validates contracts for all artifacts produced earlier; it must run after all producer tasks.
User Story 1 tasks (T001‑T004) are not independently shippable: T003 depends on the AIPW estimator from T004, violating the requirement that each US block be an independently‑shippable unit.
